title: Internal Control: Compliance, Operational and Financial
overview: Internal controls play a vital role in ensuring organizational efficiency and mitigating risk. As part of the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) framework, internal controls are essential for managing risk and maintaining compliance. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to corporate governance and Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), detailing risk responses and control measures at various management levels. The course explores controls across different business and reporting cycles, including the purchase/payment cycle, HR/payroll cycle, inventory/production cycle, long-term assets lifecycle, and collection cycle. Additionally, it covers key areas such as information systems control, safety controls, financial reporting controls, physical controls, and external reporting requirements. Participants will gain the tools and knowledge to implement effective internal controls tailored to their organizational risks.
audience: This course is ideal for finance and accounting professionals, including accountants at all levels, accounting managers, controllers, and certified financial personnel seeking to enhance their practical knowledge of internal controls, risk management, and financial reporting.
methodology: The course consists of instructor-led presentations, real-world examples, case studies, and group exercises. Participants will also be asked to present their findings and recommendations from the case studies and exercises.
competencies: Ensuring compliance with governance standards and regulations
Understanding and applying financial controls across business cycles
Analyzing and recommending improvements to control systems
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system.
Develop controls to address specific organizational risks.
Implement segregation of duties and internal controls within business cycles.
Protect information technology systems and safeguard data centers.
Design and maintain financial controls to ensure compliance.
Meet financial and other external reporting obligations.
